coverageNotes: INCOMPLETE ROUND: coverage is thin and the main limit was tooling, not the absence of gyms. Only 7 WebSearch queries returned results; the search budget for the turn (200 calls shared by all agents) ran out, and 5 planned queries were refused and never run: 'Madaraka estate Nairobi gym fitness'; 'crossfit box Nairobi Lang'ata Wilson Airport South C'; 'Nairobi CBD gym Moi Avenue Kimathi Street Koinange Street fitness'; 'Mombasa Road hotel gym fitness centre day pass non-residents Nairobi airport'; 'Strathmore University sports gym Madaraka Nairobi'. No yoga, pilates, women-only, boxing, university or club queries could be run. Per the rules I did not recall venues from memory or use other search routes, so no new venue outside the seed could be confirmed. The 7 searches that ran returned mostly travel-aggregator hotel lists, auto-generated pages and a templated directory, and named no verifiable standalone gyms in South B, South C, Nairobi West, Madaraka, Industrial Area or Lang'ata. Work done instead: opened the websites of seed venues in the area to add facts, and followed links on the official Boma and Weston hotel sites. This produced 11 seed-venue updates and 0 new venues. Area findings. South C / Mombasa Road: NextGen Gym (NextGen Mall, 6th floor) and The Boma Nairobi Health Club (Red Cross Road) are verified and active. Lang'ata: Weston Hotel gym (opposite Wilson Airport) is verified with a 2026 footer; no hours or access terms published. CBD: Platinum Fitness (Moi Avenue), Fitness & Gym Kenya (Kimathi Street, site footer 2019) and Nairobi Kenpo Karate (Mfangano Street, with gym sessions) have addresses on their own sites. South B, Nairobi West, Madaraka, Industrial Area: nothing verified; one lead only (The Headquarters Inn, Nairobi West). Seed data-quality problems found: Fitness Express is an equipment shop in Hurlingham, not a gym; South Fitness's site shows a Westlands address, not South B/C; YogaLink's site shows Kariobangi North, not Nairobi West; Muscle Health's address (Vision Plaza) does not match the CBD pin. Seed websites that did not resolve (DNS not found on 2026-10-13): fit360.co.ke, vevafitnesscenter.com, annisaafitnessandspa.co.ke, musclehealthkenya.com, outdoorfitness.co.ke, thenairobigym.co.ke, penthousegym.org, fitnessempirekenya.com, karatebylucaswanyama.com, kenyataekwondo.co.ke, fitfam.co.ke, malongofitness.com, holisticfitnessenterprise.co.ke. This is not proof of closure; the venues may still operate without a site. Not loaded or inconclusive: firstpowerfitness.com and tongilmoodo.com (503); kenyaboxingclub.com (page returned only its title); heroeztaekwondo.org (an unrelated tournament-software page); Swiss-Belinn Nairobi (Kileleshwa, outside region). Recommended follow-up with a fresh search budget: Madaraka, Nairobi West, South B and Industrial Area estate-by-estate searches; CrossFit, yoga, pilates and boxing queries; university and club gyms (Madaraka, CBD); and hotel gyms along Mombasa Road and in the CBD.
